messages:
olivia: Hey @raj — quick check. Support wants to capture the full request headers + body for a customer replay to debug a model mismatch in prod. Ticket: https://redwood.internal/t/INC-5132. Can we capture headers but redact sensitive fields?

raj: Which headers exactly? Authorization, Cookie, x-api-key, any user-identifiers? What's the minimal set support needs?

kevin: We shouldn't capture Authorization or Cookie. For other headers, prefer hashing or pseudonymizing. Current scrub config we use in staging:
```
redaction: ["Authorization", "Cookie"]
hash_headers: ["x-client-id", "x-user-id"]
store_raw_for: 0  # none by default
```
We can do a one-off with `store_raw_for: 2h` and S3 path restricted to sec-audit, retention 30d.

sec-ops-bot: Automations: Prod raw capture requires two approvers (security + SRE) and must be timeboxed. Create a ticket and include access list.

olivia: OK — I'll open INC-5132-addendum with access list (me, @kevin, @raj, support). Requesting approval window: 2 hours tomorrow 09:00-11:00 UTC. Also want to mask prompt tokens in LLM payloads — they might contain PII.

raj: Approve for 2h window. Agree mask prompt tokens: replace with `<<PROMPT_MASKED>>` in logs.

kevin: For implementation, add a post-processing step in proxy with regex: `s/("prompt":\s*").+?("\s*,)/\1<<PROMPT_MASKED>>\2/` and ensure we still capture metadata. I'll push the change to canary beforehand.

olivia: Great. I'll coordinate the window, add ticket notes (who/where/why), and run the capture. Will notify when it's live and when data is deleted. :thumbsup:
